seen.cap: OpenAMRobot 2.0, assembled. Shared roadmap model, visualization only
Cutaway: cover and panels translucent, the base internals in context
Battery: 4 + 4 EVE LF105 cells (8S LiFePO4) upright in two removable side trays, joined by the keyed connector PWR-018
Lift stop sensors on the rear face of the static column: three fixed inductive sensors, one steel flag moving with the lift (L1000, L1175, L1350)
Rear power module, cover off: F0 at the plate front, K1 and K2 joined by busbars, FB-B on its shelf above, FB-A at the rear
Two levels above the prepared wireless charging receiver, 15 mm gap; the BMS on edge in the right side gap
Base harness, cover off: power corridor on the robot's left, signal corridor on its right, covered central channels over the drive section, tie points on every run
Front bay side zones beside the two tiers: power on the robot's left (FB-C, USB-PD, 3.3 V), signal on its right (USB hub, USB-CAN-FD, LiDAR UART)
Lift energy chain behind the column at L1000: the lift cables run from DP-LIFT up in one vertical U chain
Lift moving up to L1350: the chain rolls over its 75 mm radius along the stroke
Flag rod guide at the top of the static column: an open ring holds the rod and leaves the sensor side open for the flag (L1350)
OpenAMRobot 2.0 roadmap model. Not an assembly instruction
